title: Spotlights/Features How do I search for images on the forum?

posts.author: Eternidade_1
posts.body:
I'd like to know if it's possible to create one or if there's already a way to search the forum's image gallery. All images are available with one click, so it's easy to see what's already been done and avoid rework, for example. Or even serve as inspiration for projects.
More specifically, something like Windows' search, which allows you to select files by image, scanning the hard drive.
Edit:
I found a way to view the forum's image gallery.
Access Google Images: Go to images.google.com.
Then type:
site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com filetype
ng
Tilesets: site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com tileset
Battlers: site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com battler
Facesets: site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com faceset
Parallax: site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com parallax
site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com imgur
site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com photobucket
Many creators use a standard license model. To check the terms in the search, type "License," "Terms of Use," "TOU," "Usage," "Creative Commons," or "Commercial/Non-Commercial Use Permitted."
Example: site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com tileset "License"
site:forums.rpgmakerweb.com tileset ("commercial use" OR "CC")
